mapper.select: select p.p_title as ptitle, p.p_brand as pbrand, p.p_category as pcategory, p.p_type as ptype, o.o_no as ono, o.o_main_img as omainimg, o.o_price as oprice, o.o_default as odefault, p.p_no as pno, o.o_origin_price as ooriginprice, o.o_quantity as oquantity, o.o_type_size as otypesize, o.o_color as ocolor, i.img_no as imgno, i.img_url as imgurl, p.p_content as pcontent, i.img_sort as imgsort from dc_product p inner join dc_product_option o on p.p_no = o.p_no left join dc_product_detail_image i on p.p_no = i.p_no where p.p_no = #{p_no} order by i.img_sort asc
